note: Per-event-class acceptance policy DATA (architecture v0.7 §3.3). The engine is learning/ulpf_learn/acceptance.py (P3). Classes 4001 and 4002 follow the architecture table and the worked trace; 3002 and 2004 remain drafts until a source of those classes is onboarded (P6).

enumeration.note: Candidate enumerator policy (P3, widened P4): runs over the complete pinned class table; scalar leaves only; leaf depth at most 2 dots (admits src_endpoint.ip and http_request.url.url_string); type-family compatibility plus value-domain checks: port range; epoch_auto's four disjoint 2000-2100 windows for numeric samples (P3 boundary); enum membership for every enumerated attribute, string enums included (P4: http_request.http_method is a string enum); text and word tokens accept timestamp_t and datetime_t as well as string_t because textual timestamps are text/word cells the DSL coerces (P4); integer and float tokens accept string_t because OCSF ids and codes are strings (P4); ip/mac/url stay strict. Structural determination requires exactly one survivor.

usability.note: Mandatory is a mapping obligation, not a per-event presence requirement (P2 boundary). Absence causes: structural (no span), uncoercible (span failed coercion), declared_null (pack-declared vendor marker). All three leave the event usable; time is the exception and quarantines.
